title: Fractured Memory Spiral
description: An elderly woman with a fragmented, patchwork face sits at a table under a lamp, one half of her face orange and mechanical. Below her, a swirling vortex of television static and circuitry descends into a skeletal figure and a masked duplicate of the woman, surrounded by blue virus-like symbols and retro electronics.
prompt: Surreal dark artwork showing an elderly woman with a cracked porcelain-like face patched with blue and orange mechanical pieces, sitting at a vintage table with a lamp above her. Below, a swirling spiral tunnel of old televisions, boomboxes and circuitry leads down to a glowing green skeleton and a masked duplicate of the woman, blue virus symbols floating throughout, high contrast line art with selective color on black background
